integrity: Exact rational symbolic identities and an analytic Descartes-sign proof; ten exact-rational matrices are supplementary tests, not exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact endpoint stochasticity for the unit-rate directed eight-cycle only; does not address unequal rates, other dimensions, stage values, floating-point positivity or time-accuracy. This is a self-reviewed mathematical claim with no independent validation.
title: A sharp finite stochasticity window for fourth-order Gauss steps on the directed eight-cycle
